thread_analysis.thread_summary: Harada Industries works with Allion (Toshitaka Mochizuki, Kenichi Ushiroebisu, Itsuo Sakai) on Bluetooth SIG certification, with internal coordination covering modification memo and RF/RF PHY test scope determination, followed by a DUT-to-InterLab-tester connection troubleshooting episode once the sample arrived.
all_questions_found: Is RF PHY testing tied to LE support, and which modification memo should be sent? (see thread_0002_case_01)
Why can't the InterLab system establish control over the DUT through the assumed PC-bridging connection? (see thread_0002_case_02)
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: RF PHY test necessity tracks LE support declared on the quote form; DUT-to-tester connection architecture (PC-bridging vs. direct tester connection) is chipset-specific and shouldn't be assumed to generalize across different projects.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: When test engineers lack explicit connection documentation from a customer, verify chipset-specific connection architecture rather than defaulting to a previous project's setup pattern, since bridging requirements vary by chipset.
